articles.title: FA set to withdraw support for Fifa president Infantino
articles.summary: The English Football Association is set to write to Fifa president Gianni Infantino withdrawing its support amid the fallout from his scrapped plans to sell off stakes in Fifa competitions to private

articles.title: A bruising 24 hours - what next for Fifa and under-pressure Infantino?
articles.summary: Pressure is building on Gianni Infantino. Can he survive as Fifa president after the implosion of the controversial World Cup investment plan?
